nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, assigned from msg.sender in the Owned constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string, set to JET in the Jetoncoin constructor.
Public token name string, set to Jetoncoin in the Jetoncoin constructor.
Public token decimals, set to 8 in the Jetoncoin constructor.
Total token supply, initialized in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of account address to token balance; mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the constructor.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance; mutated by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
SafeMath helper performing a + b followed by an overflow check require(c >= a).
SafeMath helper performing a - b guarded by require(b <= a).
SafeMath helper performing a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath helper performing a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender, giving the deployer ownership.
onlyOwner function setting newOwner to the supplied address for a two-step ownership transfer.
Function requiring msg.sender == newOwner, then promotes newOwner to owner and zeroes newOwner.
Jetoncoin constructor initializing symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-minting the whole supply to a fixed address.
Returns _totalSupply minus the balance of address(0), computing an unchecked subtraction.
Returns the balance of the given tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
ERC20 transfer that debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[to] using safeSub/safeAdd.
ERC20 approve that writes the spender allowance for msg.sender into the allowed mapping.
ERC20 transferFrom that debits balances[from], reduces allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits balances[to].
Returns the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner from the allowed mapping.
Sets an allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data), enabling reentrancy.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts so the contract never accepts ETH.
onlyOwner function performing an external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to rescue tokens.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance debits and allowance keys.
External unguarded call to an arbitrary spender contract in approveAndCall, executed after state updates and before returning.
External call to an owner-supplied token contract at transferAnyERC20Token, executed with the contract as caller.
Unchecked arithmetic subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply().
